reading.action: Three-part: (C) set the cold-bitten bar back into the dark cistern water to absorb more cold essence; (A) strength-train to failure (pushups, squats, rusty-bar swings) while the rivet charges; (B) once the rivet is full, carefully pull HALF its essence into himself.
reading.result: PART A (training) — DETERMINISTIC, no roll. NO attribute gain: the Tower awards attributes through advancement (level-up points), NOT rote reps — drilling alone is the 'counterfeit band' (same authorship-not-tempo rule as skills). He trains to failure and the System stays silent; he LEARNS strength is taken from the Tower, not built in the yard. COST: Stamina 42 -> 6 (wrung out to failure). No HP/Focus, no skill. | PART B (half-draw) — STRONG SUCCESS (margin 17). Rivet was full; he drew exactly HALF its charged heat-essence into himself, cleanly, stopping at the middle. RESONANT (same element as Ember) so it came home smooth — nothing like the rough cinder draw. His Ember DEEPENED (qualitative, real). COST: HP 65->60 (-5 integration sear), Focus 75->65 (-10 control). Rivet now HALF-charged, recharging in the coals. AFFINITY COUNTER TICK HELD: a real deliberate Ember-deepening absorption, but the counter gain is staged pending Alan's per-point schedule pick -> Ember Manipulation counter stays 1 for now (will apply this draw once the ramp is set). | PART C (cold bar in water) — passive, per turn-32 principle (same-element seed concentrates same-element essence). The cold-bitten bar drinks the cistern's faint cold essence, slowly RECHARGING/feeding its imbue (counteracting the Novice bleed-off, firming it a little) — but does NOT fix the Novice instability (that needs skill rungs, not just essence). Now a slow cold-well mirroring the rivet's heat-well. No roll, no cost. | NO Tower reset.
